name: ZillAPI
tagline: Give your agents fast, structured data on demand.
install_steps: Create an account at zillapi.com and get your key.
Tell your Grok Bot to reach for ZillAPI when it needs to fetch or enrich data.
Paste the prompt below to make it a standing capability.
prompt: You have access to ZillAPI (https://zillapi.com) with my key. When I ask for data — lookups, enrichment, or structured records — call ZillAPI, fetch what is needed, and return it cleanly. Never invent values; if the API has no answer, say so and stop rather than guessing.
description:
## What it does

ZillAPI gives builders fast, scalable data endpoints without standing up their own infrastructure. Connected to a Grok Bot, it becomes the bot’s way to fetch and enrich real data on demand, so answers are grounded in a live source instead of the model’s best guess.

## Use it in Grok Bot

Drop in the prompt below and a key. When you ask the bot for data, it pulls from ZillAPI and returns it cleanly — and refuses to make numbers up when the source has none.

Paste the prompt on this page into a Grok Bot and connect your account — that is the whole setup.
